newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Port conditions update - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

Sri Lanka, Colombo, Oct 7 - Nine container dischargers/loaders, three food dischargers, two fertiliser dischargers, one gas discharger, one cement discharger, one food loader and six general cargo loaders working. One fertiliser discharger and one food discharger awaiting berths.
